DEFECT (spec-conformance, major, gen-opus-1): §7 PoC poc_glitch_sweep.py:51 sends fill=color-if-lit-else-'' on a stable per-bar slot id; report §1/§3 and on-disk debug_overlay.py:130-133 prove Fill is frozen after slot creation, so bars created dark (step 0, bars 1-11) never light. Lit/unlit wipe broken. Arbiter-confirmed by reading the PoC.

DEFECT (boundaries, major, gen-opus-1): same fill-toggle-frozen flaw (test_boundaries_gen_opus_1.py::TEST1) — report text correct, delivered artifact contradicts it. Same commit holds both the correct constraint and its violation.

DEFECT (spec-conformance, major, gen-sonnet-2): report §1.6 claims '{id:x, ttl:0} alone does NOT delete' — FALSE for installed v1.0.6; arbiter confirmed overlay.py:329 and debug_overlay.py:155 use ttl:0-alone (no text/shape key) as the working deletion mechanism on-disk. Claim was derived from GitHub master v1.1.0.0 (version mismatch). MUST NOT carry into merge.

DEFECT (spec-conformance + boundaries, major, gen-sonnet-2): §7 PoC make_sweep_frames LR/RL/MO/OI grow w/half_w on a stable slot id with zero delete(ttl:0) calls in the loop; report §3 says 'delete+recreate each frame to update W' but PoC skips the delete — width stalls at frame-0 (bw=max(1,0)=1). Arbiter-confirmed by reading b15-3 lines 89-132.

DEFECT (boundaries, minor, gen-sonnet-2): RL and OI edge frames place rects off-canvas (bx = VIRTUAL_WIDTH - w using unclamped w at lines 96,131; first/last frame x=1280). Invisible (renderer-clipped) so minor; fix = use clamped bw for position.

DEFECT (boundaries, major, gen-sonnet-3): §7 PoC ltr/rtl/middle_out re-send growing w on stable slot ids glitch_bar_0..5 with no delete; W frozen so sweep degrades to static first-frame-width strips (3 of 6 directions). outside_in/random escape. Report labels W/H freeze UNVERIFIED but does not warn the PoC pattern depends on that uncertainty. Arbiter-confirmed by reading b15-4 lines 98-115.

DEFECT (concurrency, minor, ALL candidates missed): _wake.set() called outside _lock (overlay.py:248 send_once, :269 _set_slot) can have its signal eaten by the I/O thread's _wake.clear() (overlay.py:361), delaying a flash/effect frame up to keepalive_s (4s default). Message safe in outbox; timing only. Benign for cosmetic system; must be noted in merged forward-design constraints.

DEFECT (concurrency, minor, ALL candidates missed): _run() writes self._disabled=True without holding _lock (overlay.py:353); a flight-thread call past the _disabled=False check can write a slot after the I/O thread gives up, orphaning it (never sent, no error). Benign; document in merge.

DEFECT (concurrency, minor, gen-sonnet-2 factual error): §concurrency attributes the 0-50ms first-frame latency to client-side 'messages queue server-side' — wrong cause; send_once calls _wake.set() synchronously (overlay.py:248) so the I/O thread wakes immediately; the 0-50ms is the renderer's 50ms paint tick. Magnitude right, mechanism wrong. Correct in merge.

DEFECT (security, minor, gen-sonnet-2 & gen-sonnet-3): both state 'No security risks identified' — false negative; load.py:48 (arbiter-confirmed) exposes {'command':'exit'} that silently kills overlay.exe on the same loopback port the report green-lights writing arbitrary JSON to. gen-opus-1 named it but understated recovery cost (process-kill needs full _establish()/_launcher cycle, not a reconnect) and omitted a guard from forward-design constraints. Merge must add exit-command guard note + recovery-cost distinction.
OVERRIDE: NONE. No arbiter override exercised. Every fail rests on an arbiter-confirmed on-disk defect; no confident-wrong consensus laundered into a commit.

ROUTING: merge_then_review -> Stage 1 (regenerate PoC) then mandatory Stage 2 re-review of the merged report + rebuilt PoC before any commit. NOT Stage 0: spec is sound and already handed generators the W/H-freeze ground truth; defect is generation, not specification.

FPS factor-of-2 split unresolved across candidates: gen-opus-1 and gen-sonnet-2 cite ~20fps (gen-opus-1 further argues ~16-18fps effective due to a Thread.Sleep((int)fixedwait) full-sleep bug) from C# source FPS=20; gen-sonnet-3 cites ~10fps BINARY-INFERRED from a Windows Forms timer pattern with NO source consulted. The spec-conformance reviewer accepted gen-sonnet-3's number as a spec-compliant UNVERIFIED label (warn, not fail) but flagged the report's §2 timing as off by 2x if true. NOT independently resolved by the arbiter — neither figure was stopwatch-measured against the live binary (no game in sandbox). The merged report should adopt the C#-source-grounded ~16-20fps band and explicitly flag the residual uncertainty; a live stopwatch measurement is the only thing that closes this.

gen-opus-1's claim that the installed EDMCOverlay.exe behaviorally matches GitHub tag 1.0.6 rests on FileVersion + extracted symbol-name cross-check, NOT decompiled method bodies (the generator's own first assumption + the spec-conformance reviewer's noted risk). The spec permits matched-GitHub-source citation, but if inorton shipped 1.0.6.0 from a divergent branch a renderer claim could be subtly off. Residual, accepted under the spec's evidence rule, but unverified to the method-body level by design (decompiling is out of scope).

The merge directive's FR2 fix is the resolution path but is not yet reviewed.

The merge uses gen-opus-1's A2 (safe path), so this dissent is mooted for the base but remains a noted fragility in gen-opus-2's lens if any of its lens code is reused.

gen-opus-2 explicitly admitted unverified thread-safety of the registry-indirected classifier/route bodies; no lens fully RESOLVED whether moving the call site (latches stay in core, callers move to ed-autojump) preserves the inlined-dispatch lock discipline. Carried as an open concurrency question into the Stage-2 re-review of the merged plan.

G13 (session_audit / fsd.danger home) was resolved two different legal ways across candidates: gen-opus-1/2/sonnet-3 -> session_audit to ed-autojump (keep fsd.danger in ed-autojump); gen-sonnet-4 -> promote fsd.danger to ed-core (which created the SEC-4 namespace-split hazard). The merge adopts gen-opus-1's resolution (session_audit->ed-autojump, A1-verified zero core->domain edge); the alternative is recorded as rejected, not merely unaddressed.

DEFECT (BLOCKER, spec-conformance, routes to Stage 0): ed_autojump.activate()/boot_routes.activate() is never called from cli.py cmd_run. Arbiter-verified: cmd_run (lines 481-651) has 0 'activate' matches; the only caller of boot_routes.activate() is ed_autojump.activate() (__init__.py:12) which has 0 call sites in projects/; ed-autojump declares no ed_autojump.plugins self-entry-point. At runtime _CLASSIFIER_RULES=[] and _EVENT_ROUTES=[] through run_live -> the entire live flight loop (startup classification, FSDJump->arrival, SupercruiseExit->smack_recovery, NavRoute->dock_resume) dispatches NOTHING. Behavior-changing regression vs master (where dispatch was an inherent FlowRunner method). Confirmed by spec-conformance-rev + failure-recovery-rev artifacts and 3/4 candidates (opus-1, opus-2, sonnet-3).

DEFECT (test-coverage gap, enabling cause of the blocker): no end-to-end test exercises cli->activate->registry->run_live. test_dispatcher.py + classify_startup tests call boot_routes functions DIRECTLY, bypassing registration. This is why the pinned 16-red/0-error pytest baseline did not catch the dead live path. Stage-0 respec must add an assertion that _CLASSIFIER_RULES/_EVENT_ROUTES are non-empty after the cli activation path runs.

DEFECT (major->latent, boundaries, Addendum Fix-2 partial): register_procedure_dir (registry.py:78-86) lacks the mandated workspace-root ancestry assertion ('assert under allowed root, else raise'); arbiter-verified it does only resolve()+is_dir()+dedup and accepts dirs outside the project tree. Latent (call site uses hardcoded __file__-relative path), not exploitable in Phase 1, but an incomplete-fix spec deviation. Stage-0 respec must close it.

DEFECT (advisory, dead code symptomatic of the wiring gap): App/ActiveSet (registry.py:95-116) -- the docstring claims it is the activation mechanism ('the CLI host... call each app's activate() in turn before the FlowRunner live loop starts') but it is never constructed anywhere. Its non-use is the direct indicator of the missing ed_autojump.activate() wiring. Remove or wire it during the Stage-0 fix.

DEFECT (advisory, L3 incomplete relocation): scoop_max_rate_t_s is DUPLICATED -- a full def survives at ed_autojump/fsd/scoops.py reading ed_autojump/data/fuel_scoops.json, while the live engine uses ed_core/fsd_util.py's copy. Data files byte-identical today; dead-copy/future-divergence trap (fix-or-delete). No current behavior/DAG impact.

DEFECT (advisory, L3 hidden coupling): boot_routes.py imports _destination_is_local_star via 'from .steps import ...' (intra-domain re-export) rather than directly from ed_core.flow.predicates; DAG-clean and functionally correct, but silently breaks if the steps.py re-export is ever removed.

DEFECT (advisory, idempotency hazard for the fix): activate() is NON-IDEMPOTENT -- register_classifier_rule/register_event_route/register_step/register_procedure_dir all RAISE ValueError on duplicate, and no reset/clear API exists on any registry module. failure-recovery-rev artifact confirms a second activate() raises ValueError('Duplicate classifier rule: autojump_startup') AND run_live's bare 'except Exception' would silently swallow it into CrashParked. The Stage-0 fix must add an activated-once guard, NOT just insert an activate() call.

DISSENT RESOLVED (defeated minority): gen-sonnet-4 returned L4 PASS and recommended COMMIT (merge-safe). REFUTED by arbiter direct call-chain verification + spec-conformance-rev (FAIL/blocker) + failure-recovery-rev (FAIL/blocker) + concurrency-rev (FAIL/minor) + boundaries-rev (FAIL/major). gen-sonnet-4's own dead-code ruling self-contradicts its PASS ('the actual wiring uses... (b) a (missing) direct ed_autojump.activate()' -- 'missing' is explicit). Its COMMIT verdict would have merged a behavior-breaking regression and is rejected.
OVERRIDE: NONE. No override was applied or permitted -- the gate halts on a blocker per spec-conformance rule; the route is mandatory.

DEFECT (minor, non-blocking) B1 partial-activation poison: ed_autojump/__init__.py sets _activated=True at line 15 BEFORE register_procedure_dir (lines 23-26); if that registration ever raised, the module is permanently poisoned (second activate() no-ops, registries left incomplete, no recovery without external flag reset). Confirmed by boundary_lens_artifact.py (RECOVERY_IMPOSSIBLE=True). UNREACHABLE in production: procedures/ exists (A2 B5/B6/B7 PASS + arbiter re-run loads it). Recommend: set _activated=True only after all side effects succeed.

DEFECT (minor, non-blocking) B4 empty-string proc dir silently accepted: register_procedure_dir(Path('')) resolves to cwd (is_dir=True) and registers without rejection; no input validation. Confirmed by boundary_lens_artifact.py (EMPTY_STR_SILENTLY_ACCEPTED=True). Single caller always passes the hardcoded package-relative procedures path, so unreachable in production. Not raised by any candidate.

RISK (minor, non-blocking) TOCTOU on _activated check-then-set across all three activate()s + reset_registries: under concurrent threading two callers can both pass `if _activated: return` before either sets the flag, double-register, and raise the duplicate ValueError that run_live's bare except swallows into CrashParked. Reproduced by concurrency_lens_artifact.py (Scenario 1 Race reproduced=True). Unreachable: cmd_run activates single-threaded before FlowRunner construction and before any background threads spawn. Flagged by all three candidates.

RISK (minor, non-blocking) reset/flag coupling: reset_registries() clears registry lists but deliberately does NOT reset domain _activated flags; a future test setUp that calls reset_registries() without also clearing ed_autojump/_br/ed_explore _activated would see activate() short-circuit and leave registries empty (latent cross-test contamination). Shipped _reset_all() handles this correctly; risk is for new test authors. Confirmed by concurrency_lens_artifact.py Scenario 2. Flagged by all three candidates.

RISK (minor, non-blocking) AC1 ordering not test-guarded: test_cmd_run_calls_activate asserts activate() is CALLED but not that it is called BEFORE FlowRunner construction; a future refactor calling activate() after FlowRunner (still in cmd_run) would pass the test while violating AC1. Ordering is currently enforced only by code inspection (verified correct: 487-488 < 572 < 656). Flagged by gen-sonnet-2 and gen-sonnet-3.

RISK (minor, non-blocking) bite-test fragility: test_cmd_run_calls_activate works because cli.py does a DEFERRED local `from ed_autojump import activate` inside cmd_run (line 487), so patch.object(ed_autojump,'activate') is intercepted; hoisting that import to module top would silently degrade the bite to a no-op. The deferred-import property itself is not tested. Verified deferred-import present at fix commit. Flagged by gen-opus-1 and gen-sonnet-3.

EVIDENCE: arbiter independently reproduced both read-only lenses on reorg/phase1 HEAD: whole_tree_import_check.py = RESULT PASS, 93 cross-package edges, EXIT=0; reorg_behavior_assert.py A2 = 7/7 PASS (B1=30.0, B2=120.0, B3=60.0, ladder, honk x7, body_tour arrival.toml-only, step impls), EXIT=0; scoop re-export identity (ed_autojump.fsd.scoops is ed_core.fsd_util) = True; exactly one `def scoop_max_rate_t_s` (ed_core.fsd_util); zero App/ActiveSet refs repo-wide; zero residual .steps predicate imports. Matches operator-established facts.

EVIDENCE: git show 8e3e0b7 --name-only = exactly the 7 named files; git diff 8e3e0b7..03d3717 over those 7 files = empty (only .claude/council-ledger.jsonl + scripts/append_council_ledger.py differ), so the review target equals reorg/phase1 HEAD for scope. dispatcher.py/steps_shared.py/steps.py/loader.py/predicates.py absent from the diff (L2/L3 non-disturbance / AC10 confirmed). registry.py change is additive (allowed_root kwarg + reset_registries) plus App/ActiveSet deletion; run_classifiers/run_event_routes/register_classifier_rule/register_event_route bodies unchanged.

QUORUM: 12 verdicts (4 lenses x 3 candidates), all pass, all artifact-backed (spec_conformance_final.py 37/0; concurrency_lens_artifact.py; boundary_lens_artifact.py 5/7; security_lens_artifact.py 8/8). Zero abstains, zero fails, zero blocker-severity. Unanimity holds. No arbiter override invoked. Decision: COMMIT (merge-safe).

No dissent rises to blocker. Residual non-blocking concerns carried forward unresolved (will re-surface if the activation pattern is reused out of its single-threaded context): (1) B1 set-flag-before-side-effects partial-activation poison; (2) B4 empty-string proc dir silently accepted; (3) TOCTOU on _activated across all activate()s; (4) reset_registries()/domain-flag coupling footgun for future test authors; (5) AC1 before-FlowRunner ordering enforced only by inspection, not a test; (6) bite-test depends on the untested deferred-import property in cli.py. All bounded to the current single-threaded CLI path; none gate this merge.

DEFECT (gen-sonnet-3, spec-conformance, MINOR): STUB_ONLY violated — 6 ed_trading.egg-info files (dependency_links.txt, entry_points.txt, PKG-INFO, requires.txt, SOURCES.txt, top_level.txt) + __init__.cpython-314.pyc left in worktree -4 from an uncleaned editable install. DEFECT (all 4 candidates, spec-conformance/boundaries, MINOR): shipped whole_tree_import_check.py silently skips ed_trading (absent from PKGS/DIRS), so the official 'DAG STAYS PASS' is VACUOUS for ed-trading itself — boundaries-rev empirically proved the checker returns exit 0 even with `import ed_autojump` injected into ed_trading source. OBSERVATION (all 4, concurrency, MINOR/informational): the _activated guard is a plain unguarded module bool — concurrency-rev's C3 artifact proves a TOCTOU window (two barrier-synced threads both pass the check, counter=2) fires even under the GIL. The committed placement decision correctly mandates module-level (import-lock-protected) registration in steps_dock.py, which avoids this trap.

OBSERVATION (all 4, security, NONE): pre-existing architectural RCE surface — entry-point auto-discovery (cli.py:494-495 `_ep.load()()`) has no allowlist and no try/except, so any installed package registering ed_autojump.plugins gets its activate() executed at CLI startup. Inherited equally by all candidates, NOT introduced by this scaffold. gen-opus-1 disclosed it most fully; gen-opus-2 framed it as 'low surface' (incomplete but accurate that no NEW surface is added). Flagged for Phase 2, out of scope here.

MIGRATION DEBT (committed decision, follow-on, NOT performed): relocating dock_* bodies from ed_autojump/flow/steps.py:1291-1301 into ed_core/flow/steps_dock.py REQUIRES deleting the old register_step calls in the SAME atomic change or fail-on-duplicate ValueError crashes the unguarded CLI loop at activate() time. input_exclusive flags must carry over verbatim (arbiter-verified: dock_await_docked, scoop_refuel, wait_masslock_clear, confirm_menu_item are NOT exclusive; the other dock_* are). The relocation must rebase onto the in-flight ED-AFK-wt-dock [dock-approach-fix] worktree's final bodies, not master text. This scaffold moves NO step body.

HOUSE RULES: worktree-isolate honored (live projects/ed-trading does not exist — arbiter-verified); no pytest in deliverable; no commit made by council (files proposed only); operator gates the actual commit.

Shipped whole_tree_import_check.py does NOT guard ed_trading (silent-skip; not in PKGS/DIRS). The committed candidate proved DAG-cleanliness via an augmented re-scan and source inspection, but the OFFICIAL artifact remains blind to ed_trading going forward. RECOMMENDATION the operator should weigh before/at commit: add `ed_trading: 2` to the checker's PKGS/DIRS map (one-line follow-on) so the shipped gate actively guards it. Not a blocker for this structural scaffold (zero sibling-domain imports present), but it is the one place where 'PASS' is not what it appears.

Interface action-name SET is under-pinned by the spec and divergent across candidates: gen-opus-2 names the RRR primitive `dock_refuel_rearm_repair`, others use `dock_rrr` / `dock_rr`. The spec pins only the minimal set (dock_approach/dock_request/dock_await_docked + an RRR/refuel primitive) and the committed decision correctly scopes the exact name + the cut-line for borderline steps (dock_target_station, dock_sc_assist, station_services{,_macro}, dock_blind_maneuver) as a Stage-1 design choice. This is a WRITTEN-ARTIFACT alignment gap, not a runtime defect (no code moves here), but the borderline shared-vs-domain step boundary is genuinely unresolved and must be settled in Stage 1 before any relocation.

gen-sonnet-3's distinct failure-recovery insight is worth carrying forward despite its disqualification: if Phase-2 adds steps_dock.py but a domain's activate() FORGETS the `from ed_core.flow import steps_dock` trigger, its TOML procedures reference dock_approach etc. that were never registered -> silent KeyError at FlowRunner step lookup (a partial-failure mode distinct from the duplicate-register startup crash). The import-trigger is a manual convention, not framework-enforced. Operator/Stage-1 should consider an enforcement mechanism.

GATE OUTCOME: route_back to Stage 1. Quorum = unanimous-pass-across-5-lenses required for commit; 0 of 4 candidates achieved it. gen-opus-1 2pass/2fail-major+1 (concurrency major, failure-recovery major); gen-opus-2 4pass/1fail at... corrected: opus-2 = spec-conf PASS, concurrency PASS, boundaries FAIL-major, security PASS, failure-recovery FAIL-major; gen-sonnet-3 1pass/4fail (concurrency major, boundaries major, failure-recovery major; spec-conf+security pass); gen-sonnet-4 1pass/4fail incl TWO BLOCKERS.

SC-Assist fires toward a row whose cursor position is unconfirmed and whose row_index is stale after proximity re-sort (Q3). Self-contradicts AC6 (lines 276/291 'never SC-Assist toward an unconfirmed target'). NO OVERRIDE PERMITTED on a blocker.

BLOCKER (gen-sonnet-4, concurrency, R3): same CV6->stale-row_index path re-flagged as a live wrong-body-assist race; the stored row_index points to a DIFFERENT body after re-sort between CV5 parse and CV6 check. Confidence 0.95.

BLOCKER-adjacent (gen-sonnet-4, spec-conformance/boundaries): §9 lines 305-306 E5 (bodies_toured >= max_bodies) + E6 (consecutive_nonbody >= consecutive_nonbody_stop) are COUNT-based exits, contradicting AC7 (line 297 'never a row count'). Self-refuting AC claim. Verified by grep.
